variants.prompt: At the peak of a skyscraper, as the golden sun dips below the horizon, the provocative woman stands at the edge of the rooftop, lost in thought. The city sprawls out before her, a twinkling tapestry of lights, and the warm glow of the setting sun casts long shadows across her face and body. She wears a barely-there bikini that leaves little to the imagination, her porcelain skin glowing against the vibrant hues of the sunset, while her raven tresses billow gently in the evening breeze.
